title: cloudflare/cloudflare-os: an open agent workspace on Workers
friendlyTitle: Cloudflare OS is an open workspace for AI agents
summary: Cloudflare OS is an Apache-2.0 agent workspace for creating documents, building applications, and running agents with organisational context and connected systems. The repository had about 9,200 stars when reviewed and was among the day’s strongest AI-related GitHub trends.
friendlySummary: This project lets agents create documents, build apps, and work with company tools and information. It runs on Cloudflare Workers.
whyItMatters: Developers can study or self-host a full agent workspace built around Cloudflare Workers, including patterns for durable execution, tools, contextual data, and application generation. It is particularly relevant to teams already using Cloudflare’s platform.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to study or build a shared agent workspace, especially if your team already uses Cloudflare.
